Specifically, calculate two percentages: 1) the percentage of motorcyclist fatalities in collisions where parties (drivers or passengers) were wearing helmets, and 2) the percentage of motorcyclist fatalities in collisions where parties were not wearing helmets. For each group, compute this by dividing the total number of motorcyclist fatalities by the total number of collisions involving that group. Use the parties table to determine helmet usage (from party_safety_equipment fields).

    COUNT(DISTINCT c.case_id) as distinct_cases,
    COUNT(*) as party_records
FROM collisions c
LEFT JOIN parties p ON c.case_id = p.case_id
GROUP BY c.motorcycle_collision

WITH motorcycle_cases AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.case_id,
        c.motorcyclist_killed_count,
        MAX(CASE 
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 = 'driver, motorcycle helmet used'
                 OR p.party_safety_equipment_1 = 'passenger, motorcycle helmet used'
                 OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 = 'driver, motorcycle helmet used'
                 OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 = 'passenger, motorcycle helmet used'
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END) as has_helmet
    FROM collisions c
    JOIN parties p ON c.case_id = p.case_id
    WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
    GROUP BY c.case_id, c.motorcyclist_killed_count
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN has_helmet = 1 THEN motorcyclist_killed_count ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN has_helmet = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) as fatality_rate_with_helmet,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN has_helmet = 0 THEN motorcyclist_killed_count ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN has_helmet = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) as fatality_rate_without_helmet
FROM motorcycle_cases

WITH collision_helmet_status AS (
    SELECT 
        c.case_id,
        c.motorcyclist_killed_count,
        MAX(CASE 
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%motorcycle helmet used%' THEN 1
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%motorcycle helmet used%' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) AS wearing_helmet
    FROM collisions c
    JOIN parties p ON c.case_id = p.case_id
    WHERE c.motorcycle_collision > 0
    GROUP BY c.case_id, c.motorcyclist_killed_count
)
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN wearing_helmet = 1 THEN 'wearing helmets' ELSE 'not wearing helmets' END as helmet_group,
    SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) as total_fatalities,
    COUNT(*) as total_collisions,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) / COUNT(*), 2) as fatality_rate_pct
FROM collision_helmet_status
GROUP BY wearing_helmet
ORDER BY wearing_helmet
